site: Workday (Marathon Petroleum posting; any posting whose Apply is a link)
class: A phrase searched across the whole page text decided what kind of page it was, and the entry path was chosen by the planner's label instead of by what the control is
symptom: On Marathon's posting the agent stopped at the first page with 'final submission is only available through the verified gateway or human handoff', every attempt.
root_cause: Two causes. (1) on_job_description refused to call Marathon's Workday posting a posting because its footer said 'a Human Resources representative will review your request', which matched the loose pattern 'review (your|and submit)' meant for the application's own review step; without 'posting', the Apply link was not followed. (2) press_next followed an Apply link by GET only when the plan's next_kind was open_application; otherwise it clicked, and the submission guard rightly refused a click on a control labelled Apply.
why_tests_missed: Posting fixtures had no footer prose containing 'review your', and the one entry test always used next_kind=open_application.
fix: The review pattern now names the application's own review wording (review and submit; review your application/answers/responses/submission/information/details). press_next follows an Apply-labelled link by GET on a posting for any plan kind.
prevention: Classify a page from its structure (controls, fields, landmarks) or from a narrow phrase, never from a loose phrase searched over all its prose; and enter a step by what the control is, not by the planner's label.
